status_rationale: Some sources provide explicit normal-drift or normal-event/fault semantics, but no reviewed licensed release was verified to provide all required event identity, persistence, recurrence, context truth and event-disjoint evaluation fields.

class_definitions.A: Semantic new-normal candidate: documentation provides an author/operator-grounded allowed-change label or scenario and separates it from fault/attack; candidate status does not imply full M6 readiness.
class_definitions.B: Adaptation/transfer only: useful normal variation, modes, recipes, workload, or fault labels exist, but no independently grounded benign-new-normal label.
class_definitions.C: Detector-only for this question: anomaly labels may exist, but context/stream semantics do not support a defensible new-normal transition evaluation.

protocol_safeguards.notes: Only a 1,200-byte HTTP range probe of one E-Energy CSV header and a C-MAPSS resource HEAD request were made. No model or experiment was run.

adjacent_protocols.name: ReCATS: Replay-Free Continual Anomaly Detection for Non-Stationary Multivariate Time Series
adjacent_protocols.type: task-incremental continual MTSAD protocol/reference; not treated as a separate dataset in this inventory
adjacent_protocols.documented_protocol: The project README and M0 review describe known pre-partitioned tasks, with normal-only training data and normal-plus-anomaly test data for each task.
adjacent_protocols.m4_relevance: Useful comparison for task-incremental normal-only continual learning. It does not establish boundary-free unlabeled test-time adaptation and does not replace the fixed same-D SMD M4 design.
adjacent_protocols.underlying_data_license_and_schema: not audited here; paper's underlying datasets and release-level licenses require separate review

datasets.name: Drift-Aware Online Anomaly Detection in Smart Buildings
datasets.real_or_simulated: real building operation with injected control-logic attacks
datasets.dimensions: 10 numeric sensor channels plus timestamp and class label
datasets.temporal_resolution: 1 minute, verified from a 1,200-byte header/data range probe

labels.benign_normal_drift: row label 1; paper examples include after-hours/weekend HVAC shutdown and designated setpoint changes
labels.attack: row label 2; paper describes abnormal office-hour setpoint manipulation with valve inconsistency

datasets.semantic_new_normal: explicit per-row normal-drift semantics; event-level transition identity and recurrence not verified
datasets.event_identity_and_duration: not documented in reviewed sources; repeated setpoint toggling is described but attack incident boundaries/IDs are not provided
datasets.split: Paper reports 5,000 chronological normal samples for training and 100 labeled sample anchors per class; event-disjointness not verified
datasets.streaming_suitability: continuous 1-minute streams; event metadata gap remains
datasets.license: unresolved; official GitHub API reports no license and repository has no LICENSE file
datasets.acquisition: Public GitHub CSVs, about 16 MB total; no full files downloaded; official repository main pinned at f13b7699bfb9bd86f44a37c2d42882476128ae52 on audit date
datasets.m4_normal_only_transfer: possible separate building-zone external study only after license and normal-prefix protocol review; does not replace SMD M4
